name: academy
description: AI self-study platform for Chinese high school students

scripts.build: npm run build -w @lailai/academy-shared && npm run build -w @lailai/academy-api && npm run build -w @lailai/academy-web
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @lailai/academy-shared && concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @lailai/academy-api" "npm run dev -w @lailai/academy-web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @lailai/academy-shared && npm run typecheck -ws --if-present
